title: Tempo and a kick
goal: Get a four-on-the-floor kick running at 128 bpm.
explain: In this app one cycle is one bar, and the tempo comes from song.json, so you never set it in code. s("bd*4") plays the bd sample four times per cycle: the *4 is mini-notation for "repeat this step four times". Double-quoted strings are mini-notation, so spaces separate steps and every step gets an equal share of the bar. .bank("RolandTR909") picks which drum machine the bd comes from.
try_prompt: Add a four-on-the-floor 909 kick to drums.js and keep the tempo at 128 bpm.
